# Reference

## Output

| Key | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `zz` | not a key binding table |

## Keyboard

| Key | Keys (vim) | Action |
|---------------|------------|--------|
| `↑` / `↓` | `k` / `j` | Move up / down |
| `Shift+→` | `Shift+L` | Expand subtree |
| | `w` | Not bound in vim |
